title: Valve warns of data leak of Steam Machine and Steam Controller users after cyberattack on its European partner
summary: The attack on a European Valve supplier exposes customers' personal information and the company asks for caution against possible fraudulent messages.

title: Blizzard becomes Xbox's best-performing studio according to reports and leaked emails
summary: Diablo 4 and Overwatch drive Blizzard to lead Microsoft's studios, exceeding the company's expectations.

title: No Man's Sky turns 10: Sean Murray talks about Light No Fire and AI
summary: The director of Hello Games reviews the game's evolution, with less than 1% of planets explored, and defends his artisanal approach against artificial intelligence.

title: Take-Two defends GTA 6's price, its presence on Netflix, and the absence of pre-order figures
summary: The CEO of Rockstar's parent company considers 80 euros a bargain, justifies the Netflix deal, and asks for patience with the online mode.

title: Marvel Tōkon arrives on PC with serious performance issues and Arc System Works promises a fix
summary: Players report stutters and bugs in the PC launch, while trying home remedies and waiting for a patch from the studio.

title: The Division Resurgence arrives on Steam and receives mixed reviews due to its mobile game nature
summary: Ubisoft's free-to-play shooter, originally designed for mobile, lands on PC with confusion and negative player reviews.

title: Xbox will require age verification in Australia to buy and play R18+ titles
summary: From late August, Australians will need to verify their age on console and PC to access adult-rated games.

title: Square Enix reports strong profit increase and a good start to the fiscal year
summary: The company's financial results improve notably, with Final Fantasy XIV no longer being the sole source of revenue.

title: The final season of The Witcher on Netflix is delayed until 2027
summary: The last installment of the fantasy series will not arrive on the expected date and its release is unexpectedly postponed.

title: Steam refunds a Battlefield 6 player with 470 hours after Rush's removal
summary: Valve's decision to refund the money despite hours played sparks debate about a possible precedent in refund policies.

title: PS Plus allows playing on Steam Deck without needing a PS5
summary: Sony's streaming service expands its compatibility with Valve's device, although with certain limitations.

title: Ryan Hurst shows his physical preparation to play Kratos in the God of War series
summary: The actor boasts about the shape he achieved for the role before suffering a setback, and new details of the second season are revealed.
